notes.title: Early Access Update 3: Quality of Life, new Artworks & Balancing
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We know many of you are eagerly awaiting controller support, and we promise it's still in the works! In the meantime, we're thrilled to bring you a huge Quality of Life update filled with improvements, visual upgrades, and balance changes to make your experience even smoother and more fun.
A huge thank you to everyone who sent us emails, comments, bug reports, and messages on Discord – your feedback truly helps us shape the game! 

New
Added new artwork for the Steam library
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/6c21bf377bff0f1ea59a5f3e1c18a895027a61b0.png"] Added a preview button for event options – hovering over it shows a preview of the outcome
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/09a7f9b8ce8bc3f5c042c277db4ac50efe660efc.png"] Added a switch button on the character info panel and ability upgrade panel for characters with alternate forms (e.g. Hansel & Gretel)
 Added new visuals to the dice selection screen in battle to show team members and their required dice
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/d965b5c1c71668d098f3ebb0d5ecdadc4315db5a.png"]Added a new button for accessing handcard inventory
 Added a dice count display on the map and in the shop
 Added new character visuals for Sophia’s Maid and Sophia’s Minion
 Added new perma card visuals for Sophia’s Maid and Sophia’s Minion
 [spoiler] Added new character visuals for Smej’s three heads, Helpless Queen, and Real Bad Wolf (Phases 2 and 3)[/spoiler]
 Added unique avatar artwork for every character
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/5e6d6b11a1e4bcf369e479126ab3cd02e54831e0.png"]Added a “don’t show again” option to the Early Access popup in the main menu
 Added hover details for character cards and dice in the shop
 Added a new button image to close the book
 Added new images for the Misery Cards
 Added new target icon on targetable enemies when selecting an ability
 Added a text pop up when handcard limit is reached  
 The evil Hunter now spawns hunter dummies when taking damage 
 If you need a certain character for an event choice, their avatar is now shown [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/157d877831c02bed399b4a9a6d9b7d2fe04b918b.png"]
Changes   
Completely reworked the loose random handcard event outcome from 1 random selected to choosing 1 of 3 randomly selected handcards from deck 
Completely reworked the character scroll in the map screen 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/ee60ec7e723e352e7fb51584fe052bee8badb60d.png"]Redesigned the Game Over screen with new artwork 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/fa10a483454398b24ed9481155a9b19393d6f2b5.png"]Removed italic font styles to improve text readability  
Updated the game credits  Handcards in the shop are now selected from all possible character reward cards, so you won’t receive cards from characters not in your team  
Being Rooted no longer reduces Immunity  
A crown icon now appears on upgraded character cards as a visual indicator 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/40f8b0887cda2d24fe728c9d68663ac1e7592b3d.png"]Updated the battle background image for the castle map 

Bug fixes   
Fixed some localization issues  
Fixed handcard shop prices sometimes showing up wrong  
Fixed missing hover details for Jack in Jeff's shop  
Fixed an issue with Jack’s third ability not triggering correctly when using the fire variant  
Fixed receiving a status not triggering when it counters another status  
Fixed a bug where the passive ability requirement wasn't shown in the character info panel when it's an ability use requirement 

Balancing 
Numerous balance changes have been made 
Here a list of all changes in detail:

Red Riding Hood Card changes:

 Improved Bowstring: Rarity Common -> Special, Shop costs 70 -> 105

notes.title: Early Access Update 1: Bugfixes, Balancing and QOL
notes.content:
Once Upon a Rogue’s Tale Patch Notes – V 0.5.4 (11.09.2024)

Thank you for your valuable feedback! With this update we fixed some important bugs, did some necessary balancing and added some quality-of-life stuff.

New

 You can now open the character info panel by clicking on the character on the scroll in the map view
 When starting a new run while already having an active run a popup warning is shown
 Added a scrollbar to the character reserve box in the character selection panel
 Added description boxes for poison and block on the character card
 A text feedback is now shown when a character can’t be switched due to rooted

Changes

 Every effect description now explains when the effect is reduced/used
 Increased wish gain so it is possible to unlock a new character after completing your first run
 The effect Rule Breaker is now reduced by 1 after being used instead of at end of turn
 The effect Magic Fist is now reduced by 1 after the next attack instead of at end of turn
 Increased the size of status effect numbers
 Changed old font in scroll
 Ability details of Magical Prison are now hidden
 Info texts for Rübezahl-Bear and Enchanter are rewritten to fit better

Bug fixes

 Fixed a major bug where strange things would happen if you lost a boss fight
 Many localization and text fixes
 Fixed a visual bug in the character reserve box of the character selection panel
 Fixed a bug happening when having Fire Tendrils together with Swing 
 Removed the possibility to click multiple times on popup buttons resulting in getting negative wishes
[spoiler]Fixed a visual bug when using the “Adventures of the Little Tailor” difficulty setting and receiving two card rewards[/spoiler]

Balancing

 (Card-Snow White) Dwarfish Washing costs 2 -> 1
 (Card-Snow White) Dwarf Bed no longer give swing, now gives 2 Rule-Breaker
 (Card-Cloud Giant) General's Order Rule-Breaker 1 -> 2
 (Card-Gingerbread Witch) Reserve Dough costs 1 -> 2 and Endurance given 3 -> 6
 (Event-Card) Great Appetizer no longer converts dice into Joker, now gives Acceleration
 (Card-Rübezahl) Flash of Rage cost 5 -> 4, but also banishes itself
 (Card-Hunter-Brothers) Hunter Boots no longer gives Fatigue, now gives Rattled as Downside
 (Event-Card) Emperor's new Clothes Rule-Breaker 2 -> 3, Fragile 3 -> 2, costs 1 -> 2
 (Card-Jack) Backhand Beans created Extra Beans 2 -> 1, duration 2 -> 3 turns
 (Card-Jack) Milky White created Extra Beans 4 -> 3, chance of creating Super Bean 25% -> 15%
 (Card-Jack) Nimble Fingers now gives 4 -> 3 Tendrils
 (Rübezahl) 3. Skill now also stuns Rübezahl himself


We're still working on some other bugs and quality-of-life stuff, but we wanted to do a quick update because of the major boss bug. We're a small team and we're doing our best to make this game enjoyable, but please have a little patience with us! Thank you so much!

notes.title: Once Upon a Rogue's Tale is out now in Early Access! ✨
notes.content:
Dear Fairytale-Fans!

The wait is finally over - Once Upon a Rogue's Tale just launched into Early Access! 🎉
We've been working relentlessly for over a year to get to this day. We can't put into words how excited we are for your fairytale adventures!

We also offer a Special Launch discout 💸
To celebrate the release, we’re offering a 20% discount for the first two weeks! Don’t miss out on this chance to dive into the adventure at a special price.

What you can expect in the Early Access:


 3 chapters of Red Riding Hood
 3 chapters of The Frogprince
 3 chapters of Jack and the Beanstalk
 5 different acts with different enemies
 Lots of story Events
 150+ different cards
 22 playable characters
 9 unlockable difficulty Settings
 A shop between runs with more unlockable content

Of course the journey doesn't end here. We are planning to use the Early Access to deliver more content and to involve the community to get their feedback as we develop. We want to improve the game experience for everyone and make the best game we can ✨

Thank you once again for your incredible support. We hope you enjoy playing Once Upon a Rogue's Tale as much as we enjoyed creating it. Your journey begins now!

notes.title: Big Visual Demo Update
notes.content:
Dear Fairytale fans, it's been a minute since our last update post, but don't let that fool you. We have been working overtime on the new update that we are proud to present to you!

The Visual Overhaul Update is now live and shows Once Upon a Rogue's Tale in a whole new light. All UI elements have been completely reworked: Cards, buttons, backgrounds, intentions, and just about everything else in the game has been visually upgraded.

Old visuals:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/f65ca620e44e47446d99a2db7d02d09027db34ff.jpg
New visuals:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/7b9201905d5be07c6004dc0c175bba5afa1492ed.jpg

New

 Added window mode in settings menu
 Support for different aspect monitors
 New enemy: Herb Gentleman with Hazelnut
 New status effects: Rulebreaker, Acceleration, Rooted, Limping and Magic Fist
 Draw and discard piles are clickable for an overview window
 New dice button which only selects unused dice for the player
 Event Rewards and Punishments can now include status effect for the next battle
 Allowing players to re-open shops and rest sites before selecting the next map node
 New music track for the city
 Some new special effect animations for abilities


Changes

 Complete rework of visuals in main menu, battle scene and menus
 Attacks of characters can only be used a limited number of times during a turn
 Event battles now only trigger when clicking the book button after text is finished (thanks to all streamers that send in feedback <3)
 Handcard inventory now can be shown during battle and event rewards
 Number of cards in hand are now limited to 10 and everything drawn after will be discarded
 Basic hover over enemies now shows the target arrows
 More enemy set variety going from battle to battle
 Brave tailor now joins you in his event fight
 Randomization of event books buyable in Jeffini’s shop (yes, that’s her official name)
 Right click info panel overview for characters
 Buying or unlocking characters now shows the complete info panel for characters
 Changed some of the map layouts
 Healing in rest sites now heals 15 instead of 10
 Snow white event is now a character event
 One of the Musician event outcomes now gives players a buff for the next battle instead of a die
 Random ally and random opponent effects on cards and abilities now trigger without the need to select a target
 Balanced all Brave tailor abilities and costs
 Reworked Hansel and Gretel skills and added new abilities to their repertoire
 Reworked companions to be more useful and to include some of the new status effects
 Companions are now part of other classes like hunter, royalty and so on
 Energy now adds a dice overload when you got more energy than physical dice in scene (12)
 Nearly all handcards received a buff to be more useful in battle
 Stored energy effects are replaced with energy status effects
 Status effects now stop at a max value of 99
 A lot of small balance changes to enemies, characters, and handcards


Bug Fixes

 Fixed major bug that prevented playing handcards sometimes
 Fixed major bug that broke the game after an enemy is defeated in the passive state of battle
 Fixed handcards not playable when drawing new cards mid battle
 Fixed tutorial not starting new game after finishing boar
 Fixed goat hover still active when clicking goat in shop
 Fixed active passive of previous attempt stays for next run if not new passive selected
 Fixed wish lamp showing up in battle
 Fixed error message showing behind button text box
 Fixed rewards could be skipped while extra reward window is open
 Fixed some special attacks not showing the influenced values by weak or strength
 Fixed banish random card only banishing itself
 Fixed swing effect not using the correct neighbor of the target and reducing stack on each attack not only on single target
 Fixed passives of Hunterbrother and Rübezahl triggering multiple times when hit with a multi attack
 Fixed poison reducing thorns value without triggering it
 Fixed shop goat price not showing correctly after loading a game
 Fixed unplayable misery playable in battle
 Fixed helpless effect not working as intended
 A bunch of other small fixes to localization and gameplay

notes.title: Big Demo Update: The Frog Prince
notes.content:
Dear Fairytale fans, not too long ago we released a major replayability update, but guess what... Another huge update has just dropped!

The Frog Prince Update is now live and introduces a new unlockable main character with a whole new chapter including new enemies, a new boss, new events, new playable characters, and much more.

[previewyoutube=mLFSGmzDqtg;full][/previewyoutube]

New
 The first chapter of The Frog Prince

The Frog Prince wakes up one day with a strange feeling and notices that his skin has suddenly turned green. Not only that, but his entire body has been transformed into a frog! What has happened and how can he ever be a human again? It sounds like a new adventure is calling.

Notice: The Frog Prince is unlockable after your first run with Red Riding Hood. He will appear in Jeff's new Wish Shop when starting your new run - with a special demo discount!

A new main character: The Frog Prince
[spoiler]The Frog Prince comes with two forms: A frog and a human form. You can switch between those two in battle, giving you more abilities to choose from! He works best against multiple enemies as he is very skilled with his sword (...and his frog legs).[/spoiler]

6 new enemies
2 new playable characters
7 new events (including 2 character events)
A new boss
Over 30 new cards

Changes

 Bug report button added to main menu

 After displaying all the event text a continue button shows up to trigger all the punishments and rewards

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Big Demo Update: Replayability
notes.content:
Once Upon a Rogue’s Tale Patch Notes – V 0.3.0 (23.05.2024)

Dear Fairytale fans, a big demo update is waiting for you!
The Replayability Update is now live and, as the name suggests, comes with many new features and upgrades that will make your runs even more individual and offer new unlockable content.

New

 A brand new shop in between runs
Our goat Jeff found life as a simple goat that only eats cards too boring and decided to open his own store! This store features new unlockable passive abilities for your main character, new unlockable events and special one-time run upgrades for your next run. Later this will be the place where you also unlock new main characters and their adventures.
Notice: The shop will appear for the first time after your first run.

 A new resource: Wishes
After each battle, in addition to the typical battle rewards, a new bar will be filled up. When it is full, you will receive a wish that you can exchange in Jeff's new Wish Shop!

 New enemies: Little Witch and Little High-born Sir{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/b661d590989cbde49f1988de3a7b351d3797b973.png
(Little Witch will also be available as a buyable companion in the chapter 2 shop)

 New event requirements
You will now come across events where certain selection options are linked to requirements. These can be: Coins, health, team size, specific hand cards, specific characters in the team or previous events.

 New event punishments
Some of your decisions in events can now lead to you getting Misery Card, losing a certain card or transforming your main character into an animal.

 New type of handcards{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718398/d537da4aeb3403c65c652538cfb7994638756985.png
We added so-called Misery Cards to the game. These cards are supposed to be unpleasant and block your deck. You can banish some of them, but this comes at a price…

 New Map Point: Character Event
A new icon now allows you to see immediately which event gives you the chance to get an additional character.

 Added a new panel to the Help-Section

Changes
We have removed one of the 3 character abilities because you will be able to unlock them later in the Early Access version. This will further increase strategic planning and make runs more unique. 

 Adjusted Hansel’s and Gretel’s second ability
 Updated Help-Section Tutorial videos
 Changed the outcome of some events 
 Changed handcard prices in the shop
 Some balancing changes
 Changed enemy behavior so abilities aren’t repeated so often
 Changed cursor size

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where you could break the game through pressing enter repeatedly
 Fixed a save game bug
 Fixed a bug where an enemy could still attack you after being defeated
 Fixed inventory button showing up when receiving a punishment during events
 Fixed a bug that could occur very rarely where a die rolls indefinitely
 Fixed a bug where dice and money didn’t reset after starting a new run
 Lots of visual bug fixes
 Lots of localization bug fixes
